modelingDirection: Minimum detail components remain native voxels; hat shells, visors, optical frames, cloth folds and face covers use continuous meshes. Single-head rigid binding transforms voxel vertices without resampling.

visualReview.method: Viewed actual saved browser captures and contact sheets; independent geometry tests remain separate.
observations: Twelve distinct wearable silhouettes retain continuous caps, visors, conical straw shell, cloth folds and thin optical frames; native clasps, hinge blocks and grille bars remain visible.
Hat underside views show inner walls/ceilings and real open bottoms; rear mask views show loops and straps.
Front head rows show adult/child caps and adult/child/elder eyewear, earrings and masks without opaque frame or hat obstruction of eye centres.
Base-colour optical views intentionally show opaque lens geometry; supplemental material/front capture visibly shows all six pairs of eyes through the transparent lenses.
Long/short independent pins visibly enter the original crown channel on the retained topknot master; no old crown pin remains.
Four full-body combinations retain separate original body/head/hair masters and the authored bounded head yaw.
limitations: Assistant visual inspection is not human art acceptance.
Models are technical candidates, not guaranteed exact reference-image likeness.
Named static poses and triangle clearances do not imply all animation, optical or protective behaviour.
